sar.narrative: Customer C11923 reported an unauthorized $131.30 online purchase (Transaction 3583368) on their card, prompting a fraud investigation. Analysis of the customer's profile revealed widespread usage across 1,509 distinct devices and 32 billing regions, suggesting shared or compromised account access. Crucially, the device associated with the flagged transaction (D-f5e3dab905c2) is linked to four different customers, including two cards with confirmed fraud histories (C05678-K1 and C05595-K1). This device-sharing nexus with known fraudulent accounts provides strong corroborating evidence of third-party compromise. Additional transactional or device-verification evidence was not requested as the shared-device fraud footprint was sufficient to validate the customer's claim. In accordance with the bank's fraud policy regarding linked fraudulent devices (Rule FP-DEV-04), the transaction is deemed unauthorized, and the recommended actions include issuing a permanent card block, refunding the disputed amount, and placing the account under enhanced monitoring.
